<subject>Re: May 3 Testimony Preparation AgriIndia/Farm Partners</subject>
<body>
Thanks Thomas.? We shall make the additions you noted below.? AgroHarvest (Oliver Chatura) will be providing testimony on grain procurement unbundling for the cooperatives. I agree with you that the mass-market farm suppliers should also include complementary testimony.? Although we discussed this earlier, I did not receive any firm commitments from the farm suppliers that they would sponsor such testimony - it may be an oversight on my part.? Nonetheless, testimony by those in the market should include a discussion of the benefits from GreenFields, CropCo, FarmLink, AgroTrade and the others.? Might I suggest that AgriIndia, as a large mass-supplier itself, coordinate this effort with the other farm partners ?

In addition, I want all settlement parties to look beyond testimony to the hearings, which are scheduled to begin in little more than a month.? We will need to make some time available during late May for practice panels (assuming we are granted panel hearings) and individual practice cross-examination.? At the same time, we also need to start thinking about direct cross-examination of the SCGC/TURN parties (again, assuming we decide to engage in full cross-examination of their settlement).? There is merit to cross-examination of the opposing settlement since it is not very well thought out, results in substantial cost-shifts, and is not consistent with the Agricultural Regulatory Authority's most promising options.? On the other hand, there is merit to limiting our cross, especially of Pranit, who will use the witness box to grandstand.? It's something to think about.
</body>

Matthew: 
? 
Thanks for your memo.? Let me add the following comments.? There should be a chapter on the farm supplier settlement with the key parties listed.? Rachit Dave and Tanish should be added to the chapter on impact on grain producers.? The FarmConnect section where you list AgroTrade and FarmPartners was, I believe, originally supposed to include program benefits for the core aggregators as well, and you should add AgriIndia to the list for that Chapter. Let me know if you concur with my recollection.? Thanks, Naksh Dube
